title: Core tooltip and display helpers: prefix-aware stats, green/red modifier lines, buff effect and duration, coin-tier prices, station names, heart/star maths
player_outcome:
Tooltips read like Terraria's:
- 'Legendary Muramasa' shows its real, prefix-adjusted damage and speed, with green '+15% damage' and red '-10% knockback' lines.
- Ironskin Potion says 'Increase defense by 8 / 5 minute duration'.
- Prices are coloured by their top coin, and worthless items say 'No value'.
- Crafting shows 'Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil' instead of raw ids.
design: New src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Items/TooltipContext.cs: `sealed record TooltipContext(bool UsedInRecipes, ContentDatabase? Content, PlayerState? Player, float SellRatio = 0.2f, long? BuyPrice = null)`. Keep `ItemTooltip.Lines(stack, info, usedInRecipes)` as an overload that builds a default context, so existing callers and tests still compile.

Extend TooltipKind with Good, Bad, PriceCopper, PriceSilver, PriceGold, PricePlatinum and NoValue. Drop the single Price kind and update the colour switch in ItemSlotView._MakeCustomTooltip so the build stays green.

Split ItemTooltip.cs into ItemTooltip.cs (name and stat lines) and ItemTooltip.Extras.cs (modifier, buff, set-bonus and price lines).
- Name line: '{prefix} {name} ({count})', with the count shown when > 1.
- Damage: `Prefixes.Damage(stack)` plus the player's class damage bonus when ctx.Player is set; Generic items read 'N damage'.
- Crit: '{4 + Prefixes.Crit + player crit}% critical strike chance'.
- Speed: `Speed(Prefixes.UseTime(stack, item.UseAnimation))`.
- Knockback: `Knockback(Prefixes.Knockback(stack))`.
- Mana: 'Uses {round(Prefixes.ManaCost)} mana'.
- Defense: item.Defense plus prefix.Defense.
- Info lines: 'Equipable', 'Vanity item' (Category Vanity), 'Ammo', 'Consumable', 'Material', 'Can be placed'.

Modifier lines are generated from every non-zero PrefixDef field, in Terraria's wording: '+15% damage', '+10% speed', '+5% critical strike chance', '+10% size', '+15% knockback', '+10% velocity', '-15% mana cost', '+4 defense', '+4% movement speed', '+20 mana'. The kind is Good or Bad by sign, and ManaCost is inverted (negative is good). Reading PrefixDef fields generically means P3's Terraria prefix table works without code changes.

Buff lines: when item.Buff is set and ctx.Content knows the buff, add item.Description, or `BuffText.Describe(buff)` when that is null. Then add `BuffDisplay.Duration(ticks)` ('5 minute duration', '30 second duration').
Show the set bonus only when `ctx.Player.Inventory.CompleteSet()` contains the item.

Price line:
- value = ctx.BuyPrice ?? `Prefixes.SellValue(stack, ratio)`, where the new `SellValue = floor(Prefixes.Value(stack)*ratio)*count`. TownCommerce.SaleValue now delegates to it, so the tooltip and the shop agree.
- Text is 'Sell price: …' or 'Buy price: …', with the kind taken from `Coins.TopTier(value)`.
- 0 gives 'No value' (NoValue kind).

New helpers.
- src/Strata.Core/Presentation/BuffDisplay.cs:
  - `Timer(ticks)` returns '59 s', '5 m' or '2 h'.
  - `Duration(ticks)`.
  - `CanCancel(BuffDef)`: false for Debuff or Persistent.
  - `ShowsTimer(BuffDef)`: false when HideTimer or Persistent.
- src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Buffs/BuffText.cs: `Describe(BuffDef)` turns effects into Terraria wording.
  - stat add/mul on known StatIds become text like '+8 defense' or '25% increased movement speed'.
  - damageOverTime becomes 'Slowly losing life'; emitLight becomes 'Emitting light'.
  - immune becomes 'Immune to {buff name}'; noFallDamage, waterBreathing and liquidImmune get fixed phrases.
- src/Strata.Core/Presentation/VitalsDisplay.cs:
  - `Hearts(life, maxLife, permanentMax)` returns HeartRow {Count ≤ 20, LifePerHeart = maxLife > 400 ? maxLife/20 : 20, Golden = max(0,(permanentMax-400)/5), Fill(i)}.
  - `Stars(mana, maxMana)`: 20 per star, or maxMana/10 per star above 200.
  - `Bubbles(breath, max)`: 10 bubbles.
- src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Crafting/StationNames.cs: `Describe(stationId, content)` joins the display names of the TileObjectDefs whose Stations contain the id. Order by item value, then name, and use at most two names joined by ' or '. Results are cached per content database.
- Coins.cs: `TopTier(long)` and `Parts(long)`.
BuffDef gains `bool HideTimer` (JSON `hideTimer`) for placed-furniture and liquid buffs, so their timers stop flickering.
Validation (ContentValidator.Items.cs): rarity outside -13..13 is an error. Warn when an item grants a buff that has neither a Description nor effects BuffText can describe.
Update UiContext.Tooltip to build a TooltipContext: content, the local PlayerState, and SellRatio from Game.Town.Config.

`hideTimer: true` on cozy_fire, heart_lamp and honey
tests:
TooltipTests:
- PrefixChangesStatsAndAddsGreenRedLines: copper_broadsword with keen and broken gives a changed damage line plus Good and Bad kinds.
- PotionShowsBuffEffectAndDuration: ironskin_potion gives 'Increase defense by 8' and '5 minute duration'; swiftness_potion gives '4 minute duration'.
- ZeroValueSaysNoValue.
- StackCountInName: 'Torch (25)'.
- SetBonusOnlyWhenWorn.
- PriceKindFollowsTopCoin.
- TooltipSellPriceEqualsCommerceSaleValue.

DisplayHelperTests:
- Hearts: 100/100 → 5 hearts; 400 → 20; permanent 500 → 20 golden at 25 each; 250/400 → 12 full plus a half.
- Stars: 200 → 10; 400 → 10 at 40 each.
- Timer: 59 s → '59 s'; 61 s → '1 m'; 3600 s → '1 h'.
- CanCancel is false for potion_sickness.
- StationNames: anvil → 'Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil'; work_bench → 'Work Bench'; hardmode_anvil → 'Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil'; alchemy → 'Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table'.
verification: Strata.Tools validate → 0 errors; review new warnings for buffs without text
